summary: Iteration 12 retest of the critical toggle-inventory regression. The third-attempt fix (LIFTING showShopInventoryView state to App.js line 48 and passing showInventory/setShowInventory as props to ShopAndInventory) FULLY RESOLVES the bug that failed in iterations 10 and 11. Toggle flips correctly after purchasing 3 items in-session, inventory grid renders, all use-item buttons present, and the full ITEM EFFECTS chain (Monarch 2x multiplier on D-rank, Mana Crystal +1 point, Health Potion penalty negation) end-to-end works as specified. All smoke checks pass. 0 Pixabay/MP3 network requests confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 48 lift of showShopInventoryView is the correct surgical fix — App's root useState cannot be reset by any child remount or re-render cascade. Confirmed by reproduction.

App.js useEffect at line 82-93 still triggers sync on inventory change which causes a parent re-render (and previously remounted ShopAndInventory's local toggle state). Lifting state cleanly sidesteps this. Optional follow-up: memoize the inventory prop reference in useInventory for cleaner reconciliation (not blocking).

Minor: 'Health Potion negated the penalty!' toast fires twice on reload (visible in test toasts list). Likely due to React 18 StrictMode double-invocation of the penalty useEffect in dev. Harmless in production builds but worth noting; consider gating the toast with a ref to ensure single-shot.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded with epic-grind-runes=5000, epic-grind-monarch-until=ISO(+24h), epic-grind-health-potion-charges=1, then a D-rank mission created in-session for Monarch 2x verification. For penalty negation: mission flipped to isRecurring with createdDate=2025-01-01, completionData[yesterday]={}, epic-grind-penalty={active:false}, then reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toggle-inventory regression is permanently fixed via state lift to App.js. Verified scenarios: (a) BEFORE click 'View Inventory (3)' → AFTER 'View Shop' with inventory-grid visible; (b) all 3 use-item-* buttons render; (c) shadow_essence has zero use buttons (not in ITEM_EFFECTS map); (d) monarch-blessing-active badge appears after Invoke Blessing; (e) availablePoints 0→1 after Mana Crystal; (f) health-potion-charges header reads ♥ 1 after Use Potion; (g) D-rank mission completion under monarch yields exactly +200 XP and +80 Runes with toast '(2x Monarch)'; (h) reload after seeding yesterday with 0 completions consumes the health potion charge (1→0), keeps penaltyData.active=false, hides penalty banner/badge, and surfaces 'Health Potion negated the penalty!' toast; (i) 0 Pixabay and 0 MP3 requests over full session; (j) 4 nav tabs and Offline SyncIndicator pill visible.
rca of the issue: Root cause confirmed: in iters 10/11 the toggle state lived inside ShopAndInventory. When inventory state mutated in App, the auto-sync useEffect triggered a parent re-render that — combined with React reconciliation timing — caused the child's useState/useLocalStorage initializer to re-read the not-yet-persisted previous value, dropping the toggle update. Fix: hoist the boolean to App.js (a higher-stable scope), pass down as props. The boolean now lives outside any reconciliation cascade that the inventory change can affect, eliminating the race. Verified end-to-end with the exact reproduction steps from iter-11 (seed 5000 runes → buy 3 items → toggle) — toggle now flips on first click with grid rendering immediately.
